chartType.composition: Compose Recharts with Zeron Chart. These examples share the chart installation, palette, tooltip and accessible data table.
chartType.dataKeyProp: Map the chart marks to the original numeric data field.
chartType.sourceDescription: Follows the BarChart composition in support-analytics-01. The gradient example below adapts its TicketTrend presentation.
chartType.configProp: Map stable series keys to labels and shared chart colors.
chartType.tableProp: Expose the original values in a keyboard-accessible table.
chartType.dataProp: Supply original values without aggregation, implicit zeroes or reordering.
chartType.valueProp: Choose the numeric source field used by the chart.
chartType.centerProp: Supply the center summary and its business meaning.
chartType.title: Bar chart
chartType.description: Compare category values with vertical columns or horizontal bars.
chartType.gradientDescription: Adapt the gradient fill, rounded tops and bar spacing from Support Analytics (support-analytics-01). Fixed example data demonstrates the ticket trend style below.
chartType.gradientGuidance: Fade the series color from 55% opacity at the top, through 20% opacity at the 55% stop, to transparent at the bottom. Use useId to give each instance a unique gradient ID and avoid collisions between charts on the same page.
chartType.guidance: Preserve category ordering and use a meaningful zero baseline. Horizontal bars provide more space for category names. A categorical bar chart does not replace a histogram with real bucket boundaries.
